claims.statement: Raw visual HTML in apps/* UI code is forbidden (Rule 1): bare button/input/textarea/select/a/img/label/progress and styled div/span are symptoms; only zero-visual-responsibility structural tags and non-rendering plumbing are exempt.

When a primitive exists apps compose it (Rule 2): no hand-rolled recreation, no per-app copies, no second app-wide stylesheet, and styles use tokens only — hex/px/rem appear only in packages/ui/src/styles/tokens.css.

A missing primitive capability is fixed upstream in packages/ui behind a spec (Rule 3): prop/slot/variant first, a new atom/block only when genuinely reusable; app-specific behavior stays in apps/* but is composed from primitives.

Frozen surfaces require explicit user approval and move together with their guarding test: the e2e selector surface (roles, visible text, aria-labels, button.trash-delete), token values (packages/ui/test/tokens.test.ts is the value table), and PWA constants.

Four mechanical greps enforce the contract at every UI review: zero raw form/media elements in apps, zero next/link in apps, raw colors only in tokens.css, and no domain words (note|trash|tag-chip) in packages/ui code.
packages/ui/src/components holds the atoms and blocks, each with its own .test.tsx; a UI task's delegation plan must name a primitive-reuse plan element by element.
